Piyush Itankar
CE BTech VJTI 2022
Oracle Financial Software Services | FTE Interview |
On-Campus
Oracle conducted the placement drive in the second week of August. There
were a total of 3 rounds - Online test, Technical interview round 1 and
Technical Interview round 2. All students of circuit branches with CPI greater
than 7 were eligible to apply.
Round 1 – Online Test: (Around 2hrs)
The online test comprises mcqs about Quantitative and Aptitude, English
Comprehensions and core Computer Science concepts. The test was
conducted on their own testing platform. English and CS sections had a
medium level difficulty but the aptitude section was comparatively difficult
to solve. Time constraints made it worse. Here. you have to be fast with a
fair accuracy. Answers in mcqs were not allowed to change once submitted
(separate submission for each mcq).
Round 2 – Technical Interview 1: (around 40min)
Interview started with my introduction followed by a little discussion on the
Covid times and the new things I have tried my hands on during the
lockdown. Interviewer go through my resume and asked everything about
my recent project. She also cross questioned about the future scope and
limitations of the project. After this she asked me about the programming
languages I am familiar with.
After this, she asked, given a long string containing various “@”, how can
we remove all “@”. She asked me about both approaches, one involving
traversing on the complete string and the other one without traversing.
Then she asked the different ways in which we can reverse a string.

Following this she asked about palindromes and the sorting algorithms.
She asked me to write the pseudocode for removing the duplicates from a
given string.
Then she start asking questions from the core CS concepts
·
View in DBMS
·
Linear data structures v/s Non-linear data structures
·
Array v/s Linked list v/s vector
·
Doubly linked list
After this, she asked me a simple puzzle: - No. of handshakes among six
persons if every person shakes hands with every other person.
Then, she asked me about my summer internship, the projects and the
technologies I worked on during this period and asked me to sum up my
experience about my first encounter with the corporate world.
At the end, she asked me in which situations I often end up making
mistakes. Lastly, She asked me if I have any questions for her and my
interview was concluded.
Note: The interviewer asked me to use a notepad and share the screen for
coding questions and puzzles.
Round 3 – Technical Interview 2: (5 – 10 min)
This was a short interview involving some HR questions. At the start of the
interview, the interviewer asked me about the different tech stack I have
worked on and asked me to explain my internship project.
Following this, he asked me to write code for finding the largest 3rd element
of an array. Then he asked me what if I was assigned a project involving
technologies which are not familiar to me. He was pretty satisfied with my
answer and following this asked me why I chose to pursue my career in
Computer Engineering. Lastly, he asked me if I had any questions for him
and my interview was concluded.
